title: Output-blind sighash scopes in PSBT signing let a PSBT author reuse a victim signature
severity_condition: High at chain level; Critical only if a deployed consumer trusts the verifier; no named consumer
fragile_reason: the digest value is input-type dependent; taproot errors at the digest level instead of collapsing

stages.primitive: effective sighash with the SINGLE bit reaches the digest for an input index past the output count; no output-index guard
32-byte digest with no outputs commitment: legacy constant 0100...00, v0-witness zero hash, or SIGHASH_NONE
valid signature over an attacker-rebuilt transaction, accepted by btcd script engine under StandardVerifyFlags
stages.control: CELL A2-control-0x01 declared=0x01 script_engine_accepts_attacker_tx=false err=signature not empty on failed checksig

stages.primitive: collapsed digest exported in SignHashList to an external signer; returned signature verifies on the attacker transaction
stages.state_note: SDK hand-off and attach proven; external signer policy assumed

stages.primitive: a deployed consumer credits or settles on a signature this verifier accepted
stages.blocker: no live consumer in scope; funds movement not demonstrated
